create_gumbel_distribution: create a Gumbel distribution with specified loc and scale parameters
sample_gumbel_distribution: sample from a Gumbel distribution with given loc and scale
compute_gumbel_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a Gumbel distribution
get_gumbel_distribution_properties: get the mean, mode, variance, and entropy of a Gumbel distribution
expand_gumbel_distribution: expand a Gumbel distribution to a different batch shape
